scope: Orchestrator-set round-3 scope: re-test the two assertions that failed in round 2 (VAL-BOOK-003, VAL-BOOK-037) after fix commit 521df7ed, plus quick regression checks on the Today business date and the Settings conflicts panel. regressionRechecks.note: Today host list on the current business date. The service-day date now comes from the location time zone plus day_start_min instead of the UTC calendar date: at 04:01 UTC on 2026-10-17 (00:01 EDT) the day feed (no date parameter) and the Today screen's Business date control both showed 2026-10-16, which is the correct service day for day_start_min=240, while the UTC date was already 2026-10-17. 13 rows and counters 11 parties / 30 covers matched the feed. The parent captured the same probe at 03:53 UTC with a no-token 401 control (evidence/foh-core/r3-regress/parent-business-date-probe.txt).

The conflicts panel on /acme/reservations/settings still renders 10 rows (confirmation code, date, Party of N and a localized reason), matching the 10-item GET payload. The GET is now a dry run: snapshots before and after 3 panel loads plus 2 authenticated GETs were identical in every value (24 rsv_day_versions rows with unchanged versions, rsv_reservation_events COUNT 253 with unchanged MAX(at) and per-type counts, rsv_table_occupancies COUNT 160, last-5 rsv_reservations.updated_at, MAX(rsv_day_versions.updated_at)). A setup-scope token returned byte-identical 200 bodies twice; no token returned 401.

The detail sheet's Contact Tracking selector exposes the canonical values none|left_message|no_answer|wrong_number with Arabic labels and round-trips left_message -> no_answer -> left_message (200 each, sqlite confirmed). dir=rtl/lang=ar, Arabic tabs/filters/badges, LTR codes/phones/times and zero console errors all re-verified; the group's own booking is rsv_9dcf4f57-ed26-40f7-917b-c0090a597b81 (#QL7LZ3) on 2026-11-13.
Three groups ran in two batches (2 browsers, then 1 browser + curl/sqlite alone) inside the round-3 concurrency plan; no group hit a blocker, and every sqlite access was SELECT-only.

discoveredIssues.description: The Today screen has two date controls that can disagree: the Today list's Business date control and the day feed resolve 2026-10-16 (location tz + day_start_min=240, correct), but the module header Date control (#reservations-date-input) shows the App-shell UTC calendar date 2026-10-17 (apps/app/app/routes/reservations+/_layout.tsx:98). The client-computed 'Jump to Today' target has the same problem because apps/app/app/utils/reservations/book-api.ts:1526 reads dayStartMin from the payload root (raw.dayStartMin) while the response carries it at settings.dayStartMin=240, so the client value collapses to the calendar date. No contract assertion in this round's scope covers the header control, so it is reported rather than failed.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Pass the resolved business date (or settings.dayStartMin) from the loader into the shell date control and the client day-start computation so both controls show the service day the day feed uses.

discoveredIssues.description: Breadcrumbs on the Arabic reservations pages still render Latin 'Reservations / Today / Book' breadcrumb segments (same observation as round 2). It is outside VAL-BOOK-037's enumerated clauses (tabs, filters, status badges, action buttons) but visible in Arabic UI screenshots.
